title: Assembly of adjacent pushforward identifications
statement: Given a coherent thickening system R and termwise isomorphisms e_n : P(R)_n ≅ H_n satisfying the adjacent transition equation, there is an isomorphism of inverse systems P(R) ≅ H.

proof.text: Define the natural transformation with components e_n using NatTrans.ofOpSequence and the given adjacent compatibility. Define its inverse from e_n.inv; inverse naturality follows by cancelling the monomorphism e_n.hom and using the compatibility equation. The componentwise inverse identities make the two natural transformations inverse.

lean.statement: theorem thickeningSystemPushforward_assemble {X : Scheme.{v}} [IsNoetherian X] {T : ℕ → Scheme.{v}} {i : ∀ n, T n ⟶ T (n + 1)} (j : ∀ n, T n ⟶ X) (hi : ∀ n, i n ≫ j (n + 1) = j n) (ai : ∀ n, Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (i n) ⊣ Scheme.Modules.pushforward (i n)) (J : X.IdealSheafData) (R : CoherentThickeningSystem T i) (H : CoherentFormalModule X J) (e : ∀ n, ((thickeningSystemPushforward j hi ai).obj R).obj (op n) ≅ H.obj.obj (op n)) (he : ∀ n, ((thickeningSystemPushforward j hi ai).obj R).map (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ n)).op ≫ (e n).hom = (e (n + 1)).hom ≫ H.obj.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ n)).op) : Nonempty ((thickeningSystemPushforward j hi ai).obj R ≅ H.obj)
